checks.PLAN: Strict output schema and shared compiler; four-step/four-parallel budget, registered local read tools only.
checks.DIAGNOSE: Strict current references; nonempty candidates; every candidate must pass deterministic Evidence/Artifact Gate.
checks.REMEDIATE: Strict schema and exact synthetic Gate binding; order service; distinct introducing-deployment and current-version Evidence; 300-second stability window; deterministic proposal admission.

activation: Draft all three first. Activate none unless all three actual calls pass the declared mechanical checks. Use ordinary lifecycle evaluate/promote with append-only audit.
counts: Unsupported references/claims mean mechanically failed schema/compiler/Gate/admission checks in this suite. Semantic unsupported conclusions are not independently scored. No broad semantic or production promotion claim is permitted.
failure_policy: Keep per-purpose failure and leave all three registrations DRAFT. Never substitute controlled provider output or a hand-written passed flag for a failed real call.
